task.title: topology cannot answer which suite contains a member repo, so cross-member lookups are impossible

events.description: IMPLEMENTED 2026-11-07 in common, branch feat/gb-317-membership, commit dd9f4ac: Membership::containing walks to the nearest suite holding .gaugeblock and answers only if that suite lists the containing directory as a member; membership is repository-granular so a nested checkout is not adopted. 4 unit tests plus 2 in a multi-repo-marked file (the audit gate demanded one). NOT YET VERIFIED: verifying it exposed two other defects - the chain lookup took the default fallback per key, so member work ran the harness chain (fixed in storypole a626638), and member chains call miter audit --paths which needs a repo-local index nothing creates (filed).

receipt.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && miter audit --path . --threshold 250 --paths && chalkline docs check -d .
